centreDifferential._note: How AWD shares the drive front and rear: split is the front's share. type: 'open' (always the split: one spinning axle takes it all), 'viscous' (it resists the axles turning at different speeds, viscous N·m per rad/s of difference), 'lsd' (up to preload + lock × the torque through it) or 'locked' (front and rear turn together). lockable: the driver can lock it.
